integrity: The proof is a complete dihedral edge reduction with exact case inequalities for 0<t<=1, followed by an exact reciprocal identity for t>=1. A standard-library rational checker verifies the isometries, edge formulas, upper bounds on dense finite rational grids, and both equality families. Finite checks are supplementary and are not used as proof of the continuum statement. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the Fu--Yang--Liu--Li minimum-type skew James constant only for the affine-regular hexagonal plane. It does not classify all maximizing pairs or determine profiles for arbitrary regular polygons, Radon planes, or polyhedral Banach planes.
title: Exact Fu--Yang--Liu--Li skew James profile of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
